name: Armodafinil
description: The longer-lived R-enantiomer of modafinil, approved for the same sleep-related excessive-sleepiness indications. A Schedule IV controlled substance.

systems.note: Wakefulness promotion is the labelled indication.
Blood pressure and heart rate elevation are labelled.

monitors.why: Heavy hepatic metabolism with reported transaminase elevation.
